# HRCCoatings LLC

## Company Overview
HRCCoatings LLC is a professional painting and coating company based in San Diego, California. Founded in 2003 by Hector Rivera, it is a family-run, faith-based business now co-owned with his son Junior Rivera. They serve residential and commercial clients throughout San Diego County.

## Location

## Hours
7 AM - 5 PM, 7 days a week

## Services
1. Interior Painting - residential rooms, trim, ceilings, color consultations
2. Exterior Painting - siding, stucco, trim, doors, weather-resistant coatings
3. Commercial Painting - offices, retail, warehouses, tenant improvements, after-hours scheduling
4. Epoxy Flooring - garage floors, basements, flake systems, metallic finishes
5. Concrete Polishing - budget-friendly alternative to epoxy, industrial-modern finish
6. Cabinet Refinishing - kitchen and bathroom cabinets, custom colors
7. Drywall Repair - patching, crack repair, smooth finishing
8. Stucco Repair - crack repair, texture matching, protective coatings
9. Wallpaper Installation - all types, pattern matching, removal services
10. Popcorn Ceiling Removal - scraping, smoothing, refinishing

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does a painting project cost?
Project costs vary based on size, surface condition, and paint selection. HRCCoatings provides free, detailed estimates with no obligation.

### How long does a typical painting project take?
Most residential projects are completed within 2-5 days. Commercial projects vary based on scope. A clear timeline is provided during the free estimate.

### Does HRCCoatings work on weekends?
Yes, HRCCoatings is available 7 days a week from 7 AM to 5 PM.

### What paint brands does HRCCoatings use?
HRCCoatings uses premium paints from Benjamin Moore, Sherwin Williams, and Dunn-Edwards.

### Does HRCCoatings offer a warranty?
Yes, all work is backed by a 14-day satisfaction guarantee. If any concerns arise within 14 days of project completion, they will make it right.

### How often should I repaint my home's exterior in San Diego?
In San Diego's climate, most homes need repainting every 7-10 years. Coastal homes exposed to salt air may need repainting every 5-7 years.

### How long does epoxy flooring last?
With proper installation and care, garage epoxy floors typically last 10-20 years. Commercial or high-traffic areas may see 5-10 years depending on use.

### Does HRCCoatings do both residential and commercial work?
Yes, HRCCoatings serves both homeowners and businesses throughout San Diego County, including offices, retail spaces, warehouses, restaurants, and medical facilities.
